welcome.help: Create a welcome message for this guild.
welcome.longhelp:
Allow to set a 'welcome message' that would be sent every time a user join the server. Its necessary to set a channel, if not the system one would be used.
The bot allows you to choose if the message will be sent in the channel, in the user's DM or both.

To mention the user write #user, the role write #role

reward.help: Create a reward for this guild.
reward.longhelp:
Allow to set a reward for the leveling up system. A message will be sent every time a user reach a certain level and one or more roles will be given.
The message will be sent in the current channel.
You can also choose if the message will be sent in the channel, in the user's DM or both.

To mention the user write #user, the level write #level, the role write #role.

leave.help: Create a leave message for this guild.
leave.longhelp:
Allow to set a 'leave message' that would be sent every time a user leaves the server. Its necessary to set a channel, if not the system one would be used.
The bot allows you to choose if the message will be sent in the channel, in the user's DM or both.

To mention the user write #user

levelup.help: Change the level up message's text.
levelup.longhelp:
These are the commands to manage the levelup system in your guild.
You can set a 'level up message' to be sent every time a user levels up.The message will be sent in the current channel.
You can also choose if the message will be sent in the channel, in the user's DM or both.

To mention the user write #user, the level write #level`.

[The levelup system is enabled by default]

boost.help: Create a boost message for this guild.
boost.longhelp:
Allow to set a 'boost server message' to be sent every time a user boost the server.
Its necessary to set also a channel otherwise will be used the default system channel.
You can also choose if the message will be sent in the channel, in the user's DM or both.

To mention the user write #user

The 'Blacklist' feature in Discord enhances server security.
It keeps track of banned users across servers. Admins set a minimum ban count, and if it's exceeded, notifications alert the servers with the command enabled.
This helps ensure a safer and more secure server environment by identifying problematic users.

test.help: Owner diagnostics; API key generation and revocation are restricted to Untouchables and Epria. `test gc` requests JVM garbage collection; `test fix-timeline <puuid>` rebuilds stored match timelines; `test fix-timeline-patch <patch>` rebuilds timelines for every match in a patch; `test retrieveallgames <summoner>` and `test retrieveallgamesfast <summoner>` queue match history import as background Riot work; `test export-match-search` rebuilds the Mongo match_facets projection; `test regenerate champion [patch]` (also `champions`) discovers played build queues in the selected patch, forces statistics and invalidates Redis before rebuilding builds; defaults to the current patch, as does the daily 23:00 background job; `test regenerate aggregates [all|leaderboard-counts|rank-distribution|top-regions|division-counts|record-counts|metrics]` queues separate background aggregate rebuild jobs by type.
test.arguments: [gc | diagnostic | regenerate champion [patch] | regenerate aggregates [type] | pushsamplegame [GameQueueType] | retrieveallgames <summoner> | retrieveallgamesfast <summoner> | fix-timeline <puuid> | fix-timeline-patch <patch> | export-match-search]
